caption: A large speaker's cone pumps in and out as a bass-heavy track plays, and it stops moving when the music is paused.

sa.check: A large speaker with its cone visible.
The cone moves in and out.
The movement stops at some point, as the music is paused.
The stop is clean rather than a slow petering out.
The speaker is a large woofer.

pc.expect: The cone moves as a piston along its axis, in and out about its rest position.
pc.fail: The cone drifts sideways or rotates; or moves in only one direction and stays displaced; or keeps twitching irregularly after stopping.

pc.expect: When the music stops the cone stops: it returns to its rest position and stays there.
pc.fail: The cone keeps pumping after the pause; or stops frozen away from its rest position; or alternates between moving and still several times.

pc.expect: The cone keeps its round shape and its dust cap; it flexes as one piece with the surround stretching.
pc.fail: The cone ripples like water; or changes size; or the dust cap detaches; or the cone splits.

pc.expect: The cabinet stays still; only the cone and its surround move.
pc.fail: The cabinet rocks, walks or jumps with each beat; or the grille moves independently of the cone.

pc.expect: One cone in one speaker; nothing passes through the cabinet.
pc.fail: A second cone appears; or the cone vanishes; or the cone passes through the cabinet; or the speaker changes into another object.

pc.expect: The speaker's colour, logo and the room stay the same.
pc.fail: The cone changes colour; or the logo moves; or the background changes.
